entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I bought a jersey, and I think I got the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Men's Apex Pro Jersey, delivered about 57 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the fit?
It's just way too tight across the chest. I'd like to see if I can exchange it for the next size up. I haven't worn it, the tags are still on.

Of course. Let me just check our policy. Okay, yes, good news. Since it's a standard apparel item, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process an exchange or a full refund for you.

That's great to hear. Now, since I've had to wait and I'll need to repackage this and send it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble? I was hoping to buy some matching shorts.
I understand the inconvenience, but our policy for a sizing exchange covers the new item and the return label. I'm not authorized to add a promotional credit on top of the approved return.
I see. It's just that the online size chart was a bit misleading. A small credit would go a long way towards ensuring I place that next order. Are you sure there's nothing you can do?

I appreciate you asking, but for a standard exchange due to a size preference, the system is locked from generating goodwill credits. The solution we can provide is the full exchange for the correct size at no additional cost to you. I can get that started and email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. An exchange it is. Please send over the label.

Perfect. I've just sent that email. It will have all the instructions for sending back the jersey that's too tight. As soon as we see the return tracking activate, we'll ship out the new size. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
